author: polydata5
description:
Polymarket Crypto Up/Down 5-Minute Markets: Raw WebSocket Capture
	


A continuous recording of Polymarket's public WebSocket feeds for the rolling 5-minute "Up or Down"
crypto markets: the full order book and every trade of each market, plus the Chainlink price feed the
markets settle on. Every frame is stored exactly as received with a local receive timestamp. Nothing
is filtered, deduplicated, aggregated or resampled. A new UTC day is added every day.
